title: AI Assistant: overview film
description: Ask TYPO3. Approve every change. A narrated tour, recorded in this TYPO3 v14 lab, with English captions.
alt: Overview film, 52 seconds: AI Assistant for TYPO3 v14. Answers from the site’s own tools; Every write waits for you; Drafts, linked to the editor; The chat follows you. Narrated, with English captions.

transcript.text: Finding which pages sit below Features, or what the log recorded last night, takes a dozen clicks.
The AI Assistant answers questions about your site, inside the TYPO3 backend.
It calls the site’s own tools with your permissions, shows the result, then answers in plain words.
Every write stops and waits. Nothing changes until you approve it.
Approved changes land as drafts in a workspace, listed with the conversation.
The chat stays open across modules, and knows the page you are on.
AI Assistant. You approve every change.
